title: Vaught Conjecture
exact_target: Must the number of nonisomorphic countable models of any complete countable-language theory be either at most countable or equal to the continuum?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1461 (MOD-004). CC BY 4.0.
Antonio Montalbán, A Computability Theoretic Equivalent to Vaught’s Conjecture, arXiv:1206.5682v2 (2013), Section 1, first paragraph and distinction between first-order and infinitary variants.
